reuse: effects/delirium.go for the four-card-types condition (31 delirium cards on develop); 'opponent at random + attacks that player this combat if able' (Ursine Monstrosity): knight_rampager.go; Winter's 'exile any number of cards with four or more card types among them' is a chosen-set predicate (game/target_set.go / choose_cards_keyed.go) — local to this batch; Ooze X/X, Spider 1/2 reach, Angel 4/4 tokens.

cards.name: Convert to Slime

Delirium — Then if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, create an X/X green Ooze creature token, where X is the total mana value of permanents destroyed this way.

Deathtouch

Delirium — At the beginning of your end step, you may exile any number of cards from your graveyard with four or more card types among them. If you do, put a permanent card from among them onto the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
